about.title: Money makes more sense when you practice it
about.body1: Most finance courses explain theory and expect you to apply it on your own, with no safe place to get it wrong. Here you can make budgeting, debt, and investing decisions inside a game, see the result, and try again as many times as you want.
about.body2: All the content —games and books— is free and stays on this site. Nothing is downloaded or forwarded: it's played and read here, and discussed in the community.

analyzer.lesson.1.title: PER
analyzer.lesson.1.body: Compares price with earnings per share. A high P/E may require a lot of growth to be justified.
analyzer.lesson.2.title: ROE
analyzer.lesson.2.body: Measures the return generated on equity and helps gauge capital efficiency.
analyzer.lesson.3.title: Margin of safety
analyzer.lesson.3.body: The gap between price and estimated value. A larger margin can give more room for error.
analyzer.lesson.4.title: Dividend Yield
analyzer.lesson.4.body: Relates the annual dividend to the current price.
analyzer.lesson.5.title: EPS
analyzer.lesson.5.body: Earnings per share. A basic building block for calculating the P/E and evaluating profit growth.
analyzer.lesson.6.title: P/B
analyzer.lesson.6.body: Compares the market price with the book value or equity per share.
analyzer.lesson.7.title: CAGR
analyzer.lesson.7.body: Summarizes the compound annual growth of a variable over a period.
analyzer.lesson.8.title: Cash flow
analyzer.lesson.8.body: Shows the money coming in and going out. Free cash flow helps assess the ability to generate cash.
analyzer.lesson.9.title: Volatility
analyzer.lesson.9.body: Describes how much a price fluctuates. Higher volatility usually means more uncertainty.
analyzer.lesson.10.title: Beta
analyzer.lesson.10.body: Measures an asset's sensitivity to movements in the reference market.
analyzer.lesson.11.title: ROIC
analyzer.lesson.11.body: Looks at the return generated on invested capital and helps assess business quality.
analyzer.lesson.12.title: Debt / EBITDA
analyzer.lesson.12.body: Helps evaluate a company's debt load relative to its operating earnings.

analyzer.lesson.1.quote: “Don't overpay: the P/E tells you how many years of earnings you're buying.”
analyzer.lesson.1.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.2.quote: “I check the ROE to see if the owners' money is really working.”
analyzer.lesson.2.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.3.quote: “I never buy without a margin of safety — it's my cushion for when I'm wrong.”
analyzer.lesson.3.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.4.quote: “A good dividend is like the company paying you to wait.”
analyzer.lesson.4.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.5.quote: “Before looking at anything else, I check how much the company earns per share.”
analyzer.lesson.5.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.6.quote: “The P/B helps me avoid overpaying for what the company actually owns.”
analyzer.lesson.6.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.7.quote: “Steady growth, even if slow, almost always beats the kind that fizzles out fast.”
analyzer.lesson.8.quote: “When I opened my business I learned fast: you can show a profit on paper and still run out of cash.”
analyzer.lesson.8.attribution: — Mika, in Cash Flow for Small Businesses
analyzer.lesson.9.quote: “Volatility is scary in the short term, but it almost never matters in the long run.”
analyzer.lesson.10.quote: “If an asset moves more than the market, I have to be willing to stomach those swings.”
analyzer.lesson.10.attribution: — Moro, in the Expert-Level Investing Guide
analyzer.lesson.11.quote: “Before reinvesting in my business, I always ask: will this extra peso actually pay off?”
analyzer.lesson.11.attribution: — Mika, in Cash Flow for Small Businesses
analyzer.lesson.12.quote: “Borrowing to grow isn't bad, but I always calculate whether my business can really afford it.”
analyzer.lesson.12.attribution: — Mika, in Cash Flow for Small Businesses
analyzer.learn.attribution: That's how Moro explains it in the Expert-Level Investing Guide.
